No single service connects 34 St-Herald Sq to Grand Central-42 St, and no accessible station on the D/F line links directly to one, so two transfers is the minimum. The alternatives I checked (via A/C to Port Authority and the 7, or via E at 7 Av, which is not accessible) took more stops or were not usable.

FINAL ANSWER: ["D", "1", "S"]
